skill.name: altllm-portal-payments
skill.description: Create and monitor AltLLM Portal NOWPayments links, including guarded direct wallet payments through the local altllm CLI.
skill.summary: Guide AltLLM Portal crypto payment links, status polling, discounts, and direct wallet payments.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: The static external-command and system-reconnaissance alerts are mostly Markdown false positives. Real risk remains high because the skill handles wallet private keys, can initiate direct cryptocurrency payments, calls an external payment API, and references shared files outside the skill directory.

remediation.issue: Direct wallet payments can move user funds.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation for amount, token, destination, and payment-link ID before any auto-pay or pay-payment-link command.

remediation.issue: Wallet private keys are accepted through multiple paths.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment or protected file input, and reject raw command-line private keys unless the user explicitly accepts the leakage risk.

remediation.issue: The skill references shared instructions outside its package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the required preflight and session guidance inside the reviewed skill package, or include the shared files in audit scope.

remediation.issue: Payment workflows call an external Portal API endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Document the endpoint, expected data sent, and confirmation rules before creating or polling payment links.

content.value_statement: AltLLM Portal payment work can require several CLI flags and status checks. This skill guides hosted links, discounted links, polling, and guarded direct wallet payments.
actual_capabilities: Creates hosted NOWPayments payment links through the local altllm CLI.
Creates discounted payment links with explicit pay-currency and discount-code options.
Polls payment-link status with optional wait behavior.
Pays existing payment links through supported direct wallet payment flows.
Explains supported direct-payment currencies and known lookup limits.
limitations: It does not manage wallet login, API keys, billing history, or x402 credit top-ups.
Direct payment supports only eth, usdterc20, usdcerc20, usdcbase, and usdtbase.
Status and payment commands search only the newest 100 Portal payment links.
It requires a working local altllm CLI and valid Portal API responses.

use_cases.title: Create Hosted Payment Links
use_cases.description: Generate a NOWPayments link for a customer or internal account payment without direct wallet signing.

use_cases.title: Verify Settlement Progress
use_cases.description: Poll a payment-link ID and review whether it is pending, completed, expired, failed, or deactivated.

use_cases.title: Test Direct Token Payments
use_cases.description: Run guarded direct payment flows for supported EVM tokens during Portal billing validation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Hosted Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a hosted AltLLM Portal crypto payment link for 25 USD. Show the command you will run before executing it.

prompt_templates.title: Check Payment Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the status of payment link ID <id> and wait for a final state if the CLI supports it.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Discounted Link
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a discounted payment link for 100 USD with discount code SOLANA and pay currency sol. Confirm the selected token first.

prompt_templates.title: Run Direct Wallet Payment
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a direct usdcbase payment for payment link ID <id>. Confirm amount, token, destination, and terminal status before paying.

output_examples.input: Create a hosted payment link for 25 USD.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares the topup-crypto command, confirms the target Portal endpoint, and returns the hosted checkout link.

output_examples.input: Check whether payment link pl_123 has settled.
output_examples.output: The assistant polls the payment status, reports the current state, and explains whether the link can still be paid.

output_examples.input: Pay an existing usdcbase payment link from my configured wallet key.
output_examples.output: The assistant verifies the link is not terminal, confirms payment details, and runs the guarded direct payment flow.

best_practices: Confirm amount, token, payment-link ID, and base URL before creating or paying a link.
Use protected environment or file-based key input instead of raw private-key command arguments.
Check terminal payment states and supported currencies before enabling direct payment.
anti_patterns: Using NOWPayments payment links for x402 quote and settle workflows.
Paying completed, expired, failed, or deactivated payment links.
Passing wallet private keys through command arguments or storing them in chat logs.

faq.question: Does this skill create x402 credit top-ups?
faq.answer: No. It covers NOWPayments payment links. Use the separate x402 workflow for quote and settle credit top-ups.

faq.question: Can it pay a link directly from a wallet?
faq.answer: Yes, for supported currencies, after the user confirms the payment details and provides a safe private-key input path.

faq.question: Which direct-payment currencies are supported?
faq.answer: The documented currencies are eth, usdterc20, usdcerc20, usdcbase, and usdtbase.

faq.question: Can it inspect older payment links?
faq.answer: Not reliably. The documented CLI flows search only the newest 100 Portal payment links.

faq.question: Should private keys be passed as command arguments?
faq.answer: No. Use environment or protected file input because command arguments can leak through shell history and process listings.

faq.question: Does this skill manage Portal API keys?
faq.answer: No. It is not intended for wallet login, API key management, billing history, or subscription workflows.
